issues.reason: The compound rule exposes a modifier genus only when the modifier is an adjectival property predicable of the referent ('the contractor is senior', 'the wing is east'); '*the secretary is assistant' fails that test, and a role/noun modifier is 'never exposed, whatever it names'.

The unlemmatized half stands — 'Lemmatize every head and class ... nouns to singular' makes `defense_programs` wrong inside a class symbol — but the rest is refuted: a six-word office title with internal PPs is registered gap territory, the fused symbol is true and well-typed, and its head is 'secretary' (the last word sits inside a PP), so `(Inheritance ... secretary)` is the correct genus and the unreachability of the parts is the gap, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: a multi-word office / role title containing internal PPs ('assistant secretary of energy for defense programs'): the compound rules cover only modifier + head-noun fusion and the name rules only capitalized proper names

'then-President Ronald Reagan' — an office title carrying a temporal modifier attached to a name: neither the title rule (title stays in the `Name` string) nor the appositive rule (host-clause-tensed typing atom) carries the 'then-'
new_gaps: an object-predicative role complement ('was appointed <office>'): the state-result shape the parse borrows is written for adjectival results ('painted it red') and for become / turn-into kind change, not for an office conferred by an appointment verb

the role of the appointee: the non-physical-change extension of `Patient` is stated for occurrences and informational artifacts, and does not settle whether a person whose office changes is `Patient` or (by the unclear-case default) `Theme`
repair_summary: Dropped (Inheritance assistant_secretary_of_energy_for_defense_programs assistant), the barred noun-modifier genus. Lemmatized the fused title symbol to assistant_secretary_of_energy_for_defense_program in the three atoms that carry it (the standing half of issue 1); nothing else changed.
notes: The antecedent-less 'he' takes the mandated `person` witness, 'after retiring' yields `Before` with no connective atom, and the `(Past (Member ronald_reagan president))` rendering of 'then-President' is true and well-typed improvisation in the gap above.
